app.name: Caisse Enregistreuse MCP Server
app.description: Exposes kash.click API as MCP tools, enabling programmatic access to authentication, sales creation, and data listing features for shops.

ping.title: Ping
ping.description: Simple MCP server health check. Returns { result: 'OK' } if the server is alive.

data_list_payments.title: List payment modes
data_list_payments.description: Return the list of payment methods (e.g. cash, card, mobile payment) available for this shop.

list.title: List Kash accounts
list.description: List all Kash / free-cash-register.net accounts linked to an email address. Use this before account_create to check if the user already has an account. Returns an array of accounts, each with accountTitle, accountID, and a getOTPForAccount URL that can be used to request a one-time password (OTP) to retrieve the APIKEY. This endpoint is public and requires no authentication.

create.title: Create a Kash account
create.description: Create a new Kash / free-cash-register.net account. Requires an email address and a shop name (accountTitle). Optional: configType to pre-load a dataset matching your business type (e.g. 'Restaurant', 'Bakery', 'Bar', 'Retail'...), plus address and legal info. On success, returns APIKEY and SHOPID and automatically initializes the session so all other tools can be used immediately. IMPORTANT: the user must validate their email via the link sent automatically, otherwise the account may be deleted after a period of inactivity.

edit.title: Edit shop account settings
edit.description: Modify the settings of the authenticated shop account. All fields are optional. Covers: basic info (name, address, legal numbers), receipt display options, order requirements, feature flags (stock, barcodes, variations, webshop, coupons...), delivery method toggles, and third-party integrations (PayPal, Prestashop, Yavin, Viva.com).

show_infos.title: Get shop account settings
show_infos.description: Retrieve all current settings of the authenticated shop account as a JSON object. Returns the full shop configuration: name, address, legal numbers, receipt options, order requirements, enabled features, delivery methods, webshop colours, and third-party integration settings. Use this to verify invoice prerequisites before creating orders: shopName, adressline1, and companyRegistrationNum must all be set for legally valid invoices. If any are missing, prompt the user to fill them in via account_edit.

otp.title: Request a login OTP
otp.description: Step 1 of 2 for in-conversation authentication. Sends a one-time password (OTP) to the user's email address. If the user has multiple accounts, provide accountID (obtained from account_list) to target the right one. On success, an OTP code is sent by email — then call auth_login_with_otp with that code.

with_otp.title: Login with OTP
with_otp.description: Step 2 of 2 for in-conversation authentication. Exchange the OTP received by email for an APIKEY and SHOPID, and automatically initialize the session so all other tools work immediately. Call auth_request_otp first to receive the OTP by email.

logout.title: Logout / clear session
logout.description: Clear the current authentication session (APIKEY and SHOPID). After this, all tools requiring authentication will fail until a new login is performed.

create.title: Record an order
create.description: Record a new order in the connected shop. Input includes paymentMode, and items[]. Each item can be of type 'catalog' (with productId), 'department' (with price and deptId) or 'free' (with title and price). Check if the client already exists using data_list_clients and if the client exists, only specify idClient. If provided, paymentMode should correspond to a payment ID from data_list_payments_modes tool. Returns a sale confirmation JSON including: a link to the PDF invoice, and a link to a private order page showing full order details which can also be used by the client to pay online. IMPORTANT: before creating a validated invoice (payment ≠ -2), call account_show_infos to verify that shopName, adressline1, and companyRegistrationNum are all set. If any of these fields are empty, warn the user and suggest using account_edit to fill them in before issuing invoices.

edit.title: Edit an order
edit.description: Modify an existing order by its ID. Use the payment field to control the order state: -2 = keep as unvalidated quote (not paid); -1 = validate as invoice without payment; a payment method ID (from data_list_payments_modes) = record an actual payment and validate the order. Use paymentAmount to specify a partial payment amount (omit for full payment). Items can only be added or changed on unvalidated orders. Once validated, only payments can be recorded. Returns the orderID, a payment link, and a PDF invoice or quote URL.

detail.title: Get order detail
detail.description: Retrieve full order information by its unique ID, including items, client data, payment mode, and total amount.

get.title: Get a sales report
get.description: Download a synthetic HTML sales report for a given period. Period logic: omit all date fields to get yesterday's report; provide y only for a full-year report; y + m for a full-month report; y + m + d for a specific day. Returns an HTML summary including total revenue, number of orders, breakdown by department, VAT summary, and payment methods.

products.title: List items
products.description: Retrieve the list of articles (products) configured in the shop. Returns an array of products with fields like id, title, price, and departmentId. Optional parameter 'format' allows output as json, csv, or html.

departments.title: List departments
departments.description: Get all departments (product categories) defined in the shop, including their names and default tax rates. Supports format=json|csv|html.

department_groups.title: List department groups
department_groups.description: Return the list of department groups, used to organize product categories. Each group may include multiple department IDs.

clients.title: List clients
clients.description: Get the list of clients registered in the shop, including contact info, loyalty points.

variations.title: List item variants
variations.description: Retrieve product variations (declinaisons) such as size or color. Returns an array of variant definitions with value and optional price delta.

delivery_men.title: List delivery methods
delivery_men.description: List all delivery methods available for the shop, such as in-store pickup, home delivery, or courier services.

cashboxes.title: List cashboxes
cashboxes.description: List the registered cashboxes (physical or virtual) linked to the shop, including their current status and identifiers.

delivery_zones.title: List delivery zones
delivery_zones.description: Return all configured delivery zones, including area names, postal codes, and applicable delivery fees or restrictions.

relay_points.title: List relay points
relay_points.description: List all relay points where customers can pick up their orders, including address, city, and postal code.

discounts.title: List discounts
discounts.description: Return all available discounts or promotions, including their names, types (percentage or fixed), values, and conditions.

users.title: List users
users.description: List all users (cashiers, managers, etc.) associated with the shop, including their roles and identifiers.

tables.title: List tables
tables.description: Retrieve the list of tables configured in the app, used for restaurant mode or table management.

vats.title: List VAT rates
vats.description: Retrieve the list of VAT rates configured in the shop, including their title, rate percentage, and optional accounting chapter.

pending_orders.title: List pending orders
pending_orders.description: Retrieve the list of unvalidated orders (that can still be modified)

orders.title: List orders
orders.description: List either: unvalidated orders (called quotes) with creation date between from_date_ISO8601 and to_date_ISO8601 OR validated orders (called orders, invoices) with date of value between from_date_ISO8601 and to_date_ISO8601. You can also filter delivery methods (using filterDeliveryMethod).

add.title: Add a VAT rate
add.description: Add a new VAT rate to the shop configuration. Requires a title and a rate (e.g. 20 for 20%). Optional fields: accountingChapter, legal mention.

edit.title: Edit a VAT rate
edit.description: Modify an existing VAT rate by its ID. All fields are optional except the ID.

delete.title: Delete a VAT rate
delete.description: Permanently remove a VAT rate from the shop configuration by its ID.

add.title: Add an article
add.description: Add a new item/article to the shop catalog. Requires a title. Optional fields include price, department (deptID), VAT rate (vatID), barcode, stock, variations, and many more.

edit.title: Edit an article
edit.description: Edit an existing item/article in the catalog by its ID. All fields are optional except the ID. Use data_list_products to find the article ID first.

delete.title: Delete an article
delete.description: Permanently remove an item/article from the catalog by its ID.

add.title: Add a department
add.description: Add a new department (product category) to the catalog. Requires a title. Optional fields include VAT rate (vatID), price, discount, position, department group, and variations.

edit.title: Edit a department
edit.description: Edit an existing department/category by its ID. All fields are optional except the ID. Use data_list_departments to find the department ID first.

delete.title: Delete a department
delete.description: Permanently remove a department/category from the catalog by its ID.

add.title: Add a department group
add.description: Add a new department group to organize product categories. Requires a title. Optional: position, accounting chapter.

edit.title: Edit a department group
edit.description: Edit an existing department group by its ID. Use data_list_department_groups to find the ID.

delete.title: Delete a department group
delete.description: Permanently remove a department group by its ID.

add.title: Add a variation
add.description: Add a new variation type to the catalog (e.g. "Size", "Color"). Requires a title. Use variation_choice_add to add choices to this variation afterwards.

edit.title: Edit a variation
edit.description: Rename an existing variation type by its ID. Use data_list_variations to find the ID.

delete.title: Delete a variation
delete.description: Permanently remove a variation type and all its choices by its ID.

add.title: Add a variation choice
add.description: Add a new choice to a variation (e.g. "Large" to the "Size" variation). Requires a title and idVariation. Optional: deltaPrice to adjust the price, position, description, ending (marks it as last choice), unavailable.

edit.title: Edit a variation choice
edit.description: Edit an existing variation choice by its ID. All fields optional except ID. Use data_list_variations to find choice IDs.

delete.title: Delete a variation choice
delete.description: Permanently remove a variation choice by its ID.

add.title: Add a client
add.description: Add a new customer to the shop's customer file. All fields are optional: name, surname, email, phone, address, company registration number, VAT number, barcode, private/public comment, blacklist status, birth date, etc. Use data_list_clients to check if the customer already exists first.

edit.title: Edit a client
edit.description: Edit an existing customer by their ID. All fields are optional except the ID. Use data_list_clients to find the customer ID first.

delete.title: Delete a client
delete.description: Permanently remove a customer from the shop's customer file by their ID.
